Title: Add a private friend ride-request form and confirmed rides view
Problem / Request: Start the invite-only friend-request phase prompted by a confirmed Saturday 4:00 AM airport ride. Provide a simple private form for a known adult to request a ride and a driver-only view for requested and confirmed rides. Keep this separate from official shift telemetry and from any public interest form.
Acceptance Criteria: A private request form captures requester name, contact method, requested pickup date/time, pickup location, destination, passenger count, notes, and consent. Each request receives an ID, source, created/updated timestamps, and status REQUESTED, CONFIRMED, DECLINED, CANCELLED, or COMPLETED. The driver dashboard shows the next confirmed ride and a compact requested/confirmed list. Friend requests use a separate DEV data sheet and never become official shift/trip records automatically. Deterministic ?mode=test fixtures make no writes. There are no fares, payments, public listings, automatic matching, or automatic dispatch. Production remains untouched until separate approval.
Last Error: GitHub Actions rejected forbidden runtime marker ScriptApp. Corrected only the reviewed request-link base lookup to PULSE_FRIEND_REQUEST_BASE_URL in Script Properties.
